changes.comment: ai-assist: add IAiCacheRequest (systemBreakpoints + cacheKey), validateAiCacheRequest/validateCacheBreakpoints, and IProviderCompletionParams.cache? — the Anthropic adapter splits system into content blocks carrying cache_control on cacheable-prefix boundaries, and the OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses adapters split the leading system message into content parts carrying prompt_cache_breakpoint, plus prompt_cache_key when cacheKey is supplied. cache is gated to confirmed-supporting descriptors (supportsPromptCacheBreakpoints, true only for 'openai') — every other apiFormat: 'openai' descriptor (xAI, Groq, Mistral, Ollama, openai-compat) gets the same request body it would have gotten had the caller passed no cache at all. Additive and optional; an un-annotated request is byte-identical to before (C3 of ai-assist-prompt-caching).
